source.note: Built 2026-10-20 from the reformatted Algebra 1 course (HSAlgebra1/Q3-Q4 Module Formatted folders). Module and item titles, order, sub-headers, points, grading types and Wiris LTI links (quiz id + lookup uuid) were read from the product master copy export (9th-grade-algebra-1-product-master-copy-export.imscc): the course was never deployed to Canvas the old way and has no Module Maps in the formatted set, so the export is the naming authority. Standard course: items marked HONORS ONLY are left out (they belong to 1200320). Lessons and assignment pages are on https://optimaondemand.github.io/hs-algebra-1 (videos on https://optimaondemand.github.io/hs-algebra-1-videos). Gradebook groups and weights (40/40/20) from the course owner. No week pacing exists in the course files, so no item carries a week. One title typo in the export (Lesson 8.03a 'Inependent Practices') is corrected to 'Independent Practice' in the title and page text; the Wiris link binds by quiz id and uuid, not title.
